SELECT t.TRADER code FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT etr_add.TRADER FROM ETR_ENTRUST_ADD etr_add INNER JOIN ETR_ENTRUST etr ON etr.ENTRUST_ID = etr_add.ENTRUST_ID ) t
t.TRADER like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%'))

SELECT t1.FINPROD_ID tradeId, t1.FINPROD_ID intiTradeId, t4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID origRepSecId, t2.PLEDGE_NUMBER origRepSecNum, t2.PLEDGE_NUMBER* t2.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE origPrintAmt, t2.PLEDGE_RATIO * 100 origConRatio, t6.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, t8.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, t8.DEAL_CUR_ACCT acctNo, t1.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, t1.TERM term, t1.PRIN tradeAmt, t1.INT_RATE*100 yield, to_char(t1.VPAY_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') fristSettleDate, to_char(t1.MPAY_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') expireSettleDate, t1.ACT_CAP_DAYS occupyDays, t1.M_INT_AMT intAmt, t1.M_TRADE_AMT expireSettleAmt, t1.COUNTER_ID counterId, t7.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, t8.TRADER trader, t8.COUNTER_SEAT seatId, t8.BUSI_PS repPs, t7.REMARK addCla, t3.type_7 ps, t8.COUNTER_CON_NO agreeOnId FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT t1 INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE t3 ON t3.FINPROD_ID = t1.FINPROD_ID AND t3.BRANCH = t1.BRANCH AND t3.TYPE_6 = 'H01' AND t3.TYPE_7 IN('03','04') LEFT JOIN FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE t2 ON t2.FINPROD_ID = t1.FINPROD_ID AND t2.BRANCH = t1.BRANCH LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT t4 ON t4.FINPROD_ID = t2.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t5 ON t5.FINPROD_ID = t1.FINPROD_ID AND t5.BRANCH = t1.BRANCH AND t5.PS in ('T01') INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD t6 ON t5.TRADE_ID = t6.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST t7 ON t7.ENTRUST_ID = t6.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD t8 ON t8.ENTRUST_ID = t7.ENTRUST_ID WHERE t5.f_trade_id = #{tradeId} AND t1.BRANCH = 0

SELECT t8.trade_id tradeId, t8.trade_id intiTradeId, t4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID origRepSecId, t2.PLEDGE_NUMBER origRepSecNum, t2.PLEDGE_NUMBER* t2.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE origPrintAmt, t2.PLEDGE_RATIO*100 origConRatio, t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID newRepSecId, t9.PLEDGE_NUMBER newRepSecNum, t9.PLEDGE_NUMBER* t2.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE newPrintAmt, t9.PLEDGE_RATIO*100 newConRatio, t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID repSecId, t9.PLEDGE_NUMBER repSecNum, t9.PLEDGE_NUMBER* t2.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE printAmt, t9.PLEDGE_RATIO*100 conRatio, t7.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, t8.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, t8.DEAL_CUR_ACCT acctNo, t7.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, t8.TERM_DAYS term, t7.ENTRUST_AMT tradeAmt, t7.PRICE*100 yield, to_char(t8.VPAY_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') fristSettleDate, to_char(t8.MPAY_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') expireSettleDate, t8.cap_days occupyDays, t8.M_INT_AMT intAmt, t8.M_TRADE_AMT expireSettleAmt, t7.COUNTER_ID counterId, t7.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, t8.TRADER trader, t8.COUNTER_SEAT seatId, t8.BUSI_PS repPs, t7.REMARK addCla, t7.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, t7.PS ps, t8.request_id reqOnId, t8.COUNTER_CON_NO agreeOnId FROM ETR_ENTRUST t7 INNER JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD t8 ON t8.ENTRUST_ID = t7.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_PLEDGE t9 ON t9.ENTRUST_ID = t7.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT t10 ON t10.FINPROD_ID = t9.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE t2 ON t2.FINPROD_ID = t8.trade_id AND t2.BRANCH = 0 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT t4 ON t4.FINPROD_ID = t2.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID WHERE t7.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}

select distinct PTL_CAPACCT_INFO.Acct_No id from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY inner join PTL_CAPACCT_INFO on PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.Portfolio_Id = PTL_CAPACCT_INFO.Portfolio_Id where 1 = 1
AND PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID = #{userId}
select ftp.M_TRADE_AMT from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp where ftp.FINPROD_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
